explication: OmniGet is a cross-platform desktop downloader, media toolbox, and AI-agent workspace. Its primary download path begins with a URL, magnet, torrent, or batch input; platform handling and download engines retrieve media into local files. Separate product branches provide media tools, study features, browser-extension capture, and agent runtimes with permissions, jobs, loops, and MCP. The tree and README establish these capabilities, but most implementation excerpts are partial or absent, so subsystem-level links are limited to documented workflow relationships.
